svg.title: WebGL Academic Presentation
svg.desc: Six live Three.js slides for a WebGL seminar. Banner with the icosahedron logo tile and WEBGL ACADEMIC PRESENTATION wordmark over a cyan point field like slide 1, stack chips Next.js 16, React 19, Three.js and TypeScript, and the 3D Mathematical Graphing slide in a browser window.
svg.text: Six live Three.js slides for a WebGL seminar

g.text: Visualize complex equations in a 3D coordinate
system. WebGL transforms abstract formulas into
Distinct X, Y, Z Axis markers
x = cos(2t), y = t, z = sin(2t)
